name: 38105 · Memphis, TN
findings: ZIP 38105 (Memphis) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38105 (Memphis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 38105 (Memphis) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
